faq.q1: Does the AI sound natural or like a bot?
faq.a1: Ansai uses Claude Opus 4.7, one of the most advanced language models out there. You set the tone once (warm, formal, humorous, whatever you want) and the AI replicates your style. Your customers won't notice. In fact, in tests with real owners, 90% couldn't distinguish human responses from those generated by Ansai.
faq.q2: Can I edit responses before publishing?
faq.a2: Of course. That's actually the default mode. You get a notification with each new review and suggested reply. Approve, edit or reject with one click. You can also set auto-reply only for 5-star reviews, where risk is minimal.
faq.a3: Ansai always escalates critical reviews or those with sensitive words ("food poisoning", "bug", "theft") for manual approval. Plus, it alerts you via WhatsApp or email so you can act fast. The AI never makes decisions that could harm your reputation.
faq.a4: Less than 5 minutes. Connect your Google account, answer 4 questions about your business and tone, done. Ansai starts processing your historical reviews and generating responses. First response ready in less than 1 minute.
faq.a5: Full GDPR compliance. EU servers. Encrypted data at rest and in transit. We don't sell or share information with third parties. You can export or delete all your data whenever you want.
faq.a6: Yes. No commitments, no fine print. Cancel with one click from your dashboard and stop paying next month. If you leave, we export your data. No hard feelings.
